adaptation_note: The ASP.NET control is shown on the source site-not-found state. Laravel intentionally preserves its stricter existing fail-closed site resolution: an unknown or foreign site is rejected before the React workspace renders. The source-equivalent recovery intent is therefore exposed as a tenant-derived Back to sites navigation on the real Comments workspace without weakening the 404/IDOR boundary.
